enhancement.prompt: Create a faithful, polished gallery-cover enhancement from this exact Ascend 18 Cross merchant food-poster reference. Use its photographic food as the edit target. Preserve the partial white bowl of dark brown soup at the top background and reddish wooden table where framing permits. Remove only the promotional text and NEW badge through cropping/clean presentation; do not add branding or words. Improve warm natural light, clarity and texture conservatively while keeping the food, arrangement, portion and viewing angle faithful. Do not add egg, new ingredients, dishes, utensils, people or invented interior. This is an enhanced merchant reference, not independent ingredient, portion or current-stock certification.
